subject: Activate and verify visible ThresholdStudy homepage V3
body: Pull the visible V3 homepage switch, verify homepage_wysiwyg points to the threshold-promoted template, validate both promoted CSS signatures and compile the renderer. Return canonical evidence.

argv: from pathlib import Path; p=Path('dore-design/new-westside/homepage-v3-threshold-promoted.html'); s=p.read_text(); assert '.hero{min-height:660px;' in s and '.hero-art{position:absolute;inset:0 0 0 54%;' in s; w=Path('dore-design/homepage_wysiwyg.py').read_text(); assert 'homepage-v3-threshold-promoted.html' in w; print('VISIBLE_HOMEPAGE_V3_PASS')
